title: The Morning Digest: October 8, 2026
dek: Hurricane Isaias (75 mph, possibly Cat 3) tracks toward a Mobile landfall early Oct 10 with ~511 kb/d of Gulf oil shut in; Houthi strikes killed three at Saudi airports and a tanker took projectiles north of Qatar. Wednesday's session was sold on the IEA agreeing to accelerate the strategic release and prioritize diesel: WTI settled $88.28 (-$1.16), Brent $100.20 (-$0.38); overnight Brent Dec ran back to ~$102.35 (+~2.2%). The diesel crack settled $105.87 Wednesday, its third straight close above $100. ICE (Oct 7): TMW Nov26 -$24.62, Dec26 -$25.15 still the widest tenor; ARV Nov26 -$15.69. EIA: crude drew 3.2 Mbbl vs +1.7 expected; Cushing built a third week.

sources.publisher: Reuters via Hindu BusinessLine live blog
